message:
I remember the first time we had a power outage that lasted longer than a couple of hours. It was a chilly evening, and just as I settled in with a cozy blanket and my favorite book, the lights flickered off. No biggie, I thought—I had my flashlight ready. But when I reached for my phone to check the time, I realized it was almost dead. Talk about timing! 

I quickly grabbed my power bank, and it hit me how vital it is to keep those tech lifelines charged, especially when the unexpected happens. Now, I always keep my devices topped up, just in case. 

What little tricks do you use to stay comfortable during a blackout?
